prompt:
Using the reference image as the exact character identity: the reference shows a small coral
pixel critter (the Anthropic "Clawd" pixel mascot) holding a checkered flag. Redraw THIS SAME
CRITTER as an adorable ANGEL version of itself, in a cute designed-sticker pixel-art style:
crisp flat blocky pixel shapes with a soft, plush, charming energy — not a rigid grid port,
not mushy painterly rendering, not 3D, not glossy.

THE CRITTER: same identity as the reference — a stepped, blocky coral body (coral #DD775B,
slightly darker #c05f45 shading low on the body, a lighter #ea9077 highlight band near the
top), two big dark rounded eyes each with a single small white glint, and little dangling
pixel legs hanging below the body as it floats.

THE ANGEL: classic scalloped angel wings growing from BEHIND the body, one on each side —
cream and off-white (#fffdf7 / #f3ead9) feathers in neat scalloped rows. The wings attach
behind the body; they are never held and never attach in front.

PALETTE OVERRIDE: render the ENTIRE mascot as a ONE-COLOR sticker mark in solid warm cream #fffdf7 — body, wings, legs, halo and heart all the same single cream, with the eyes, eye glints and wing scallop separations knocked out as negative space (the green background showing through), so it prints cleanly in one ink on a dark burnt-orange shirt. ACCESSORY: halo above the head and a small floating heart beside it. No flag.

COMPOSITION: the critter floats centered, large in frame, entirely surrounded by background.
BACKGROUND: a single flat solid field of pure bright green #00FF00 and nothing else — no
shadow, no reflection, no surface, no gradient, no vignette; the green touches all four edges.
ABSOLUTELY NO text, no letters, no numbers. Do NOT include the checkered flag from the reference image.
